name: 8.5 Additional Information and Full Hypothesis Test Examples
_note: Built 2026-08-12. Two reuses (q7-ht-one-mean, q17-full-ht-one-mean-fresh-2 - both health=ok, never filed) plus ten authored (q46-read-the-significance-level, q47-tail-from-alternative, q48-full-z-test-mean, q49-full-proportion-test, q50-mean-or-proportion-procedure, q51-test-stat-to-decision, q52-type-errors-for-a-full-test, q68-draw-the-picture, q69-two-tailed-picture, pre-frq-grade-a-full-ht-workflow) = twelve. Points 8x11 + 12 = 100 (rebalanced from the SPEC's 110 on 2026-08-14 to the every-assignment-is-100 rule). BookSHelf 8.5 is additional information and full hypothesis test examples: reading the level of significance, deciding left/right/two-tailed from the alternative alone, and carrying full tests end to end for a single mean (z with sigma known, t with sigma unknown) and a single proportion, plus stating the Type I and Type II errors for a test in the wording of the problem it came from. Pre-FRQ mirrors frq/inference-for-proportions/q14-full-ht-workflow-context.php; dropped category is TEST STAT + P-VALUE (the mirror's third rubric line - a plausible answer writes the hypotheses and reaches the decision and conclusion without ever showing the arithmetic).
_aid_source: CREATED 2026-08-16 - the only assessment this repo has ever created in 334437; everywhere else the ch1-12 scaffold is reused. copyfrom 23258795 (hw template), undated, copydates unchecked.

questions.title: Full hypothesis test for one population mean (p-value approach) with randomized story contexts
Full HT for One Mean (Fresh Context 2) - Compute t-statistic, p-value, decision at alpha for a one-mean test with a randomized story context
Read the Significance Level - alpha as a decimal, and what it commits you to before the data arrive
Tail from the Alternative - the tail the test runs on, and why the symbol in Ha names the test
Full Z-Test for a Mean - z, p-value, decision, and conclusion when sigma is known
Full Proportion Test - z, p-value, decision, and conclusion for a one-proportion test
Mean or Proportion Procedure - which procedure the scenario calls for, the deciding facts, and the first number
Test Statistic to Decision - t, p-value from tcdf, and the decision at alpha
Type Errors for a Full Test - both errors stated in context from the stated hypotheses
Draw the Picture - where the curve is centered, and where the shaded region sits for a one-tailed test
The Two-Tailed Picture - why the shading is split, and what the two regions together represent
Pre-FRQ Grade a Full HT Workflow - the scenario and grading checklist of the full-HT-workflow FRQ, where the student grades four sample responses against the rubric instead of writing one
